mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_com_cd WHERE grp_cd = #{grpCd} AND use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_ord, cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_com_cd (grp_cd, cd, cd_nm, dc, sort_ord, use_at, etc_1, rgtr) VALUES (#{grpCd}, #{cd}, #{cdNm}, #{dc}, #{sortOrd}, #{useAt}, #{etc1}, #{rgtr})
